additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
I hope this email finds you well. My name is Shrey, and I’ll be assisting you with the case created in reference to the Proactive Monitoring Activity.
Below, you’ll find the relevant details regarding the product and our observations during the proactive monitoring activity.
Product: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset: Y2 / RN 313392372017
Charger ID/Serial No.: gYpkgM , zwSBae
Problem Description: Estop button pressed.
We have reviewed the logs for both chargers and identified that the Estop button has been pressed continuously since September 21st. We need to schedule a site visit to inspect the following issues as specified.
1. Please physically check if the Emergency button has been pressed. If it has, kindly release the button and monitor if the issue persists.
2. If the issue continues without any errors in the physical estop button, please inspect for any loose connections and refer to the wiring diagram provided below.
Check XD31 & XD32 terminals for power supply with the help of multimeter.
Check XD23, XD38, XD34 and XD9 terminal as shown below.
